notes:
Moagram 13.2.1 preview 1

- Updates the Telegram base to 13.2.1 while retaining Moagram features.
- Makes the updates page match the other settings pages, with shorter text.
- Removes the install-count checkbox. Anonymous usage reporting remains on by default; previously saved opt-outs are respected. Reports contain a random install ID and app version, with no Telegram account, phone number, or message data.
- Includes the background notification fixes from preview 11.

Android 6.0 or later. Install over your existing Moagram app to keep accounts and settings.
critical_message: This update brings Telegram 13.2.1, the latest Moagram fixes, and a simpler update screen. Please install it.
